provenance.note: Sampled from the Swiss Ephemeris library as a numeric oracle. The engine implements these quantities from published formulas (IERS Conventions 2010, Capitaine et al. 2003, Stephenson / Morrison / Hohenkerk 2016, Stephenson 1997, the classical Placidus semi-arc). Swiss Ephemeris C source was not copied.
